# LigandMPNN (bundled subset)

Source and weights from [dauparas/LigandMPNN](https://github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN), MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

This directory keeps only the files CheMoDesign runs: `run.py`, `data_utils.py`, `model_utils.py`, and the three checkpoints `ligandmpnn_v_32_020_25.pt`, `solublempnn_v_48_020.pt`, and `proteinmpnn_v_48_020.pt`.
